title: Peanut Jamaican Chicken Bowl
description: A flavorful and spicy dish featuring chicken cooked in a Jamaican-inspired peanut sauce, served in a bowl with charred vegetables.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with jamaican jerk seasoning.
Cook the chicken in a skillet with olive oil until browned on both sides.
Transfer the chicken to the oven and cook until cooked through.
In a blender, combine peanut butter, soy sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar.
Heat the peanut butter mixture in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the cooked chicken to the skillet and toss to coat with the peanut butter sauce.
Cook the red onion and bell pepper in a skillet with olive oil until charred.
Serve the chicken in a bowl with the charred vegetables.
